owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

rules.title: pickle/marshal/shelve load on external data
rules.description: Unpickling executes __reduce__ on the incoming object graph. A crafted payload is arbitrary code execution, by design of the format.
rules.remediation: Use JSON for data interchange. If you need pickle, sign the payload with HMAC and verify before loading.

rules.title: yaml.load() without SafeLoader
rules.description: PyYAML's default loader constructs arbitrary Python objects from !!python/object tags.
rules.remediation: Call yaml.safe_load(), or pass Loader=yaml.SafeLoader explicitly.

rules.title: node-serialize / funcster unserialize
rules.description: These libraries restore functions from their source text, which is remote code execution on untrusted input.
rules.remediation: Use JSON.parse(). If you need richer types, use a schema-validated codec.

rules.title: PHP unserialize() on request data
rules.description: unserialize() invokes magic methods on the reconstructed objects, which POP-chain gadgets turn into code execution.
rules.remediation: Use json_decode(). If unserialize is unavoidable, pass ['allowed_classes' => false].

rules.title: Java ObjectInputStream.readObject()
rules.description: Java deserialization gadget chains in common libraries turn readObject into arbitrary code execution.
rules.remediation: Use a data format (JSON/protobuf). If you must, install an ObjectInputFilter allowlist.

rules.title: BinaryFormatter / LosFormatter / NetDataContractSerializer
rules.description: Microsoft documents BinaryFormatter as unsafe and has removed it; it is directly exploitable with public gadget chains.
rules.remediation: Migrate to System.Text.Json or another contract-based serializer.

rules.title: Marshal.load / YAML.load in Ruby
rules.description: Both reconstruct arbitrary Ruby objects and are exploitable with known gadget chains.
rules.remediation: Use JSON.parse or YAML.safe_load with an explicit permitted_classes list.

rules.title: XML parser with external entities enabled
rules.description: An XML parser that resolves external entities will read local files and make outbound requests on the attacker's behalf (XXE).
rules.remediation: Disable DTD processing and external entity resolution. In Python use defusedxml.

rules.title: Jackson polymorphic default typing enabled
rules.description: Default typing lets the JSON payload name the class to instantiate, which is the Jackson deserialization RCE pattern.
rules.remediation: Use @JsonTypeInfo with an explicit, allowlisted subtype registry.
